verdict.rationale: Mistral documents optional regional inference through dedicated API endpoints that route model execution to EU or US infrastructure. Its open-weight models can also be self-hosted anywhere, which gives users a choice of geography. However, the docs describe where inference runs, not where stored data (logs, uploaded documents, conversation state) lives, and only two regions are offered. Missing for 10: explicit data-at-rest storage residency guarantees, coverage of stored artifacts such as libraries and conversations, more than EU/US region options, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Mistral offers regional inference as an optional service through dedicated API endpoints... currently the European Union or the United States.
